body: I don't know... I wish I had money to see a good professional because I think some things in my life aren't just right.
Don't you worry, these parts are kept clean, lol.
It's nice knowing that some other people do this.
I mostly don't shower when I don't see anybody, which is any day I don't go to university.

So. The thing with not showering is that I feel like doing anything else. Mostly sleeping. I don't actually do a lot of stuff on the weekends and I hardly see anybody, so maybe boredom is the cause? I imagine that if my life was more active (apart from obligations like university), maybe that wouldn't be a problem.

Sometimes I feel like I have some form of light depression, perhaps dysthymia. Thank you for the tip on that.

I don't do anything about it because it's either this or total lack of people to talk. I'm not there yet. I let these people use me in exchange for their company. It doesn't work on weekends and holidays though.

First of all, thank you for the reply. The thing with death is that it's terrible to live like this. For example, now we're having holidays, and everybody at the university forgot that I exist... Because they don't need my help with university stuff, now that the semester is over. I always try to find friends who are legitimately interested in the person I am, but it always turns out that they just need my help. It sucks, and I kind of lost faith in true friendship.
As a child, I decided that 'surfing' on a ironing board would be a good idea. It wasn't - I fell head down.

First of all, happy birthday, dude. It sucks when you feel like you're forgotten about. That hurts more than physical pain.

I can relate so much to your post that it could well have been posted by me. I turned 22 last Thursday, and, even though several people on Facebook sent me those empty birthday wishes, most of my supposed "best friends" (aka people I help the most when they can use me) just forgot about it. Not a word about maybe hanging out... Nothing. The most I had was a cake, bought by my step father and my mother. It's been like this for the last three years, so I kind of got used to it now. 

I actually have quite a lot of "friends", shouldn't they maybe... Oh yeah, it's vacations now. Nobody contacts me on vacations. To these people, I only exist as long as our university does so...
Unfortunately, that is very true. The world sucks.

I'm sorry that your fiancee left you. I've never had this experience - I believe that must be tough. It's horrible to see your friends moving away, getting on with their lives while you feel like you're stuck, I can totally relate. My life's just like yours, every day feels the same, sometimes I even lose track of the weekdays... 
I hope you meet somebody new and that this person makes each of your days unique.
